name: Metabase
description: Search, query, build and edit in Metabase (Cloud or self-hosted): explore databases and tables, run SQL, saved questions and dashboards, create and edit questions, models, metrics, collections and dashboards, and manage alerts, subscriptions, segments and timelines.

base_url.label: Metabase URL
base_url.help_text: The address you open Metabase at, e.g. https://yourcompany.metabaseapp.com or https://metabase.example.com (https:// required). Include the sub-path if Metabase is served from one, e.g. https://example.com/metabase.

api_key.label: API Key
api_key.help_text: Create one in Metabase under Admin → Settings → Authentication → API keys (Metabase 0.49+). The key acts with the permissions of the group you assign it, so pick a group that can see only the data and collections the agent should use.

gateway_header_name.label: Gateway Header Name (optional)
gateway_header_name.help_text: Custom header required by your reverse proxy, e.g. X-Gateway-Secret. Supply both gateway fields or leave both empty.

gateway_header_value.label: Gateway Header Secret (optional)
gateway_header_value.help_text: Secret value for the gateway header. Stored in the connection credentials alongside the API key. Use printable ASCII without line breaks.

get_current_user.description: Return the Metabase user the API key acts as. Useful to check the connection works.

email.description: User email (API-key users have a generated address).

is_superuser.description: Whether the key has admin rights.

group_ids.description: Permission groups the key belongs to.

list_databases.description: List the databases connected to Metabase. Use the ids with get_database_schema and run_sql_query.

engine.description: Database engine, e.g. postgres, bigquery-cloud-sdk, snowflake.

is_sample.description: Whether this is Metabase's sample database.

get_database_schema.description: List the tables in a database, optionally with their fields, 50 per page by default. Filter by schema or table name on large warehouses, or page with limit and offset.

schema.description: Only return tables in this schema (case-insensitive).

table_name_contains.description: Only return tables whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

include_fields.description: Include each table's fields (default false; can be large).

limit.description: Tables per page (default 50, max 200). Use total to see how many matched.

offset.description: Number of tables to skip, for paging.

semantic_type.description: Semantic type, e.g. type/PK or type/FK.

foreign_key_target_field_id.description: For foreign keys, the id of the field it points to.

get_table.description: Get a table's fields with their types and foreign keys. Use before writing SQL against the table.

table_id.description: Table id from get_database_schema or search.

semantic_type.description: Semantic type, e.g. type/PK or type/FK.

foreign_key_target_field_id.description: For foreign keys, the id of the field it points to.

search.description: Search Metabase for saved questions, models, metrics, dashboards, collections, tables and databases.

query.description: Text to search for. Leave empty to list recent items of the chosen types.

models.description: Limit results to these item types: card (saved question), dataset (model), metric, dashboard, collection, table, database, document. metric needs Metabase 0.51+ and document needs 0.57+ (and isn't in every open-source release); if this Metabase rejects them they are left out and the result has a note.

archived.description: Search trashed items instead (default false).

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging.

archived.description: Whether the item is trashed.

note.description: Item types left out because this Metabase doesn't support them.

list_collections.description: List the collections (folders) the API key can see. Personal collections are left out unless include_personal is true.

archived.description: List trashed collections instead (default false).

id.description: Collection id ('root' for the top level).

is_personal.description: Whether it is a personal collection.

archived.description: Whether it is trashed.

list_collection_items.description: List the questions, models, dashboards and sub-collections inside a collection.

collection_id.description: Collection id, or 'root' for the top level (default).

models.description: Only return these item types. metric needs Metabase 0.51+ and document needs 0.57+ (and isn't in every open-source release); if this Metabase rejects them they are left out and the result has a note.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging.

note.description: Item types left out because this Metabase doesn't support them.

create_collection.description: Create a collection, optionally inside another collection.

parent_collection_id.description: Optional parent collection id. Omit to create at the top level.

get_question.description: Get a saved question (card), including its SQL when it is a native query and the parameters it accepts.

display.description: Visualization type, e.g. table, bar, line.

native_sql.description: The SQL text when the question is a native query.

archived.description: Whether the question is in the trash.

parameters.description: Filter parameters the question accepts (id, slug, type, ...).

run_question.description: Run a saved question and return its rows. Pass parameters to set the question's filters.

parameters.description: Filter values in Metabase's format, e.g. [{"id": "<parameter id>", "type": "category", "target": ["variable", ["template-tag", "region"]], "value": "EU"}]. Copy id, type and target from get_question's parameters.

name.description: Column name used as the key in each row object.

base_type.description: Metabase type, e.g. type/Integer or type/Text.

rows.description: Result rows as objects keyed by column name (duplicate names get a _2, _3 suffix).

total_row_count.description: Number of rows Metabase returned before max_rows was applied.

truncated.description: True when more rows existed than were returned (max_rows or Metabase's 2,000-row API limit).

run_sql_query.description: Run a single read statement (SELECT, WITH, EXPLAIN, SHOW, DESCRIBE or VALUES) in the database's own SQL dialect and return its rows. The SQL is parsed in the database's dialect first: more than one statement, any write inside it (WITH ... DELETE, SELECT ... INTO) and functions with side effects such as nextval() are refused before reaching Metabase. Column names and quoted text are not mistaken for writes. This blocks common writes, not every write: only a read-only database user in Metabase blocks them all. Metabase returns at most 2,000 rows; aggregate or add LIMIT for large tables. Metabase permissions apply.

name.description: Column name used as the key in each row object.

base_type.description: Metabase type, e.g. type/Integer or type/Text.

rows.description: Result rows as objects keyed by column name (duplicate names get a _2, _3 suffix).

total_row_count.description: Number of rows Metabase returned before max_rows was applied.

truncated.description: True when more rows existed than were returned (max_rows or Metabase's 2,000-row API limit).

create_question.description: Save a SQL query as a question in Metabase. SQL with {{ }} filters needs each filter defined in filters; it is then checked as Metabase expands it. Optional [[ ]] clauses are refused.

database_id.description: Database id the SQL runs against.

collection_id.description: Collection to save into. Omit for the top level.

filters.description: Defines each {{name}} the SQL uses (snippets {{snippet: name}} and saved questions {{#12}} are found automatically).

name.description: Name used in the SQL, e.g. region for {{region}}.

type.description: text, number or date for a value put into the SQL; field for a field filter that filters a column (needs field_id).

display_name.description: Label shown on the filter (default: the name).

required.description: Whether a value is always needed (needs a default).

field_id.description: For type field: the column it filters (from get_table).

widget_type.description: For type field: the filter widget, e.g. category, string/=, number/between, date/all-options (default category).

display.description: Visualization type, e.g. table, bar, line.

native_sql.description: The SQL text when the question is a native query.

archived.description: Whether the question is in the trash.

parameters.description: Filter parameters the question accepts (id, slug, type, ...).

get_dashboard.description: Get a dashboard with its cards (questions), tabs and filters.

archived.description: Whether it is trashed.

series.description: A combined chart's other questions (id, name); use id as question_id in update_dashboard_filters connections.

create_dashboard.description: Create an empty dashboard. Add questions to it with add_question_to_dashboard.

collection_id.description: Collection to save into. Omit for the top level.

add_question_to_dashboard.description: Add a saved question to a dashboard. The card is placed below the existing cards; other cards are left as they are. Add cards to the same dashboard one at a time, not in parallel: Metabase replaces the whole card list on each update, so parallel additions can overwrite each other.

width.description: Card width in grid units (default 12, max 24).

tab_id.description: Tab to add the card to. Defaults to the first tab.

dashcard_id.description: Id of the new dashboard card.

card_count.description: Number of cards on the dashboard afterwards.

update_dashboard.description: Change a dashboard's name, description, collection (moves it), width, or whether filter changes apply straight away. Only the fields given change.

description.description: New description (an empty string clears it).

collection_id.description: Collection to move the dashboard into.

width.description: fixed (default Metabase layout) or full (full browser width).

auto_apply_filters.description: true applies filter changes straight away; false shows an Apply button.
Whether filter changes apply straight away.

archived.description: Whether the dashboard is in the trash.

cards.description: Cards with position, size and tab.

update_dashboard_cards.description: Move, resize, retitle, move to another tab, or remove cards on a dashboard. Only the cards listed change; the rest are sent back as they are. Get card ids (dashcard_id) and positions from get_dashboard. The grid is 24 columns wide. Change one dashboard at a time: Metabase replaces the whole card list on each update, so parallel changes can overwrite each other.

dashcard_id.description: Dashboard card id (from get_dashboard, not the question id).

tab_id.description: Tab to move the card to.

title.description: Title shown on this dashboard (the saved question keeps its own name).

remove.description: true removes the card from the dashboard. A question saved in a collection is kept; one saved inside this dashboard (Metabase 0.54+) goes to the trash with its last card, and restore_item brings it back.

auto_apply_filters.description: Whether filter changes apply straight away.

archived.description: Whether the dashboard is in the trash.

cards.description: Cards with position, size and tab.

add_text_to_dashboard.description: Add a text card (Markdown), a heading, or a link card to a dashboard. Placed below the existing cards unless row is given. Add cards to one dashboard one at a time.

text.description: Markdown for a text card, or the heading text. Required for text and heading.

url.description: Address for a link card. Required for link.

tab_id.description: Tab to add the card to. Defaults to the first tab.

row.description: Row to place the card at (default: below the existing cards).

width.description: Width in grid units (default 24, or 8 for links).

height.description: Height in grid units (default 3 for text, 1 for headings and links).

update_dashboard_tabs.description: Set a dashboard's tabs: give the full list in the order wanted. Tabs with an id are kept (and renamed); tabs without an id are created; tabs left out are removed. A tab can only be removed once its cards are moved or removed with update_dashboard_cards. An empty list removes every tab when all cards are on one tab (Metabase 0.49 can't remove the last tab, so there one tab is kept; Metabase shows no tab bar for a single tab). When a dashboard gets its first tabs, its cards go on the first one.

tabs.description: Every tab the dashboard should have, in order.

id.description: Existing tab id (leave out for a new tab).

auto_apply_filters.description: Whether filter changes apply straight away.

archived.description: Whether the dashboard is in the trash.

cards.description: Cards with position, size and tab.

note.description: Set when Metabase kept one tab.

update_dashboard_filters.description: Set a dashboard's filters: give the full list. Filters with an id are kept and changed (changing a filter's type clears its old default); filters without an id are created; filters left out are removed, along with their card connections. Give connections to say which column (field_id, from get_table) or SQL filter (template_tag, from get_question) each card's filter drives; when connections is left out, a kept filter keeps its existing connections. Removing a filter that a subscription sets a value for makes Metabase turn that subscription off and email its creator.

filters.description: Every filter the dashboard should have, in order.

id.description: Existing filter id (leave out for a new filter).

type.description: Filter type. temporal-unit (time grouping) needs Metabase 0.50+.

default.description: Default value(s), e.g. ["Gizmo"], "past30days" or [true] for a Boolean filter. null clears it.

required.description: Whether a value is always needed (needs a default).

linked_filter_ids.description: Ids of other filters that narrow this filter's choices.

connections.description: Cards this filter drives, replacing its earlier connections (list each question of a combined chart you want kept). Each needs dashcard_id and exactly one of field_id or template_tag.

field_id.description: Column the filter applies to, for query-builder questions.

template_tag.description: Name of the SQL question's filter variable, e.g. category for {{category}}.

question_id.description: For a combined chart: which of its questions (from get_dashboard's series) this connection drives (default: the card's own question).

auto_apply_filters.description: Whether filter changes apply straight away.

archived.description: Whether the dashboard is in the trash.

cards.description: Cards with position, size and tab.

copy_dashboard.description: Copy a dashboard. By default the copy shows the same questions; copy_questions also makes copies of each question.

collection_id.description: Collection to put the copy in (default: the original's collection).

copy_questions.description: true also copies every question on the dashboard (default false).

uncopied_questions.description: Questions Metabase left off the copy, such as ones this API key can't read or archived ones (only when there are any).

note.description: Says why questions are missing from the copy (only when there are any).

run_dashboard.description: Run every question on a dashboard (or one tab) with filter values, and return each card's rows. Filters not given use their defaults. Each question is checked the same way as run_question before it runs. At most 25 cards are run, and it stops early (reporting the rest as skipped) to answer within about two minutes and a few MB of rows; a card that fails reports its error without stopping the rest.

tab_id.description: Only run the cards on this tab.

filters.description: Filter values. filter is the filter's id or slug (from get_dashboard).

max_rows.description: Rows to return per card (default 20, max 2000).

cards.description: One result per card: dashcard_id, card_id, card_name, then columns/rows/row_count/truncated, or error.

skipped_card_count.description: Cards not run: over the 25-card limit, or after stopping early.

skipped_reason.description: Set when it stopped early for time or size, with how to get the rest.

get_revision_history.description: List the saved versions of a question, model, metric, dashboard or segment, newest first. Use a revision_id with revert_to_revision.

revisions.description: Versions: revision_id, description, timestamp, user, is_creation, is_reversion, most_recent.

revert_to_revision.description: Put a question, model, metric, dashboard or segment back to an earlier saved version. The revert is itself saved as a new version, so it can be undone. A question whose earlier version has SQL that writes is put straight back and an error is returned.

revision_id.description: Version to go back to (from get_revision_history).

new_revision_id.description: Id of the version the revert saved.

update_question.description: Change a saved question, model or metric: name, description, SQL, chart type, chart settings or collection. Only the fields given change. New SQL is checked the same way as create_question, and replaces the question's query. Its {{ }} filters and snippets are kept when the new SQL still uses them (new ones are defined in filters), and SQL using them is checked as Metabase expands it. Optional [[ ]] clauses are refused. Chart settings given are merged into the saved ones; a setting set to null is removed.

sql.description: New SQL, a single read statement in the database's own dialect.

collection_id.description: Collection to move the question into.

filters.description: New {{ }} filters the new SQL uses (with sql only). Filters the question already has are kept without listing them; listing one replaces its definition.

name.description: Name used in the SQL, e.g. region for {{region}}.

type.description: text, number or date for a value put into the SQL; field for a field filter that filters a column (needs field_id).

display_name.description: Label shown on the filter (default: the name).

required.description: Whether a value is always needed (needs a default).

field_id.description: For type field: the column it filters (from get_table).

widget_type.description: For type field: the filter widget, e.g. category, string/=, number/between, date/all-options (default category).

display.description: Visualization type, e.g. table, bar, line.

native_sql.description: The SQL text when the question is a native query.

archived.description: Whether the question is in the trash.

parameters.description: Filter parameters the question accepts (id, slug, type, ...).

copy_question.description: Copy a saved question, model or metric. The copy is named 'Copy of …' unless name is given.

collection_id.description: Collection to put the copy in.

display.description: Visualization type, e.g. table, bar, line.

native_sql.description: The SQL text when the question is a native query.

archived.description: Whether the question is in the trash.

parameters.description: Filter parameters the question accepts (id, slug, type, ...).

create_query_builder_question.description: Save a point-and-click (query-builder) question. People can open and change it in Metabase's editor without SQL.

query.description: Query-builder (MBQL) query, e.g. {"source-table": 12, "aggregation": [["count"]], "breakout": [["field", 34, {"temporal-unit": "month"}]], "filter": [">", ["field", 56, null], 100]}. Field ids come from get_table. source-table can be a table id or "card__<question id>". SQL is not allowed here.

display.description: Visualization type, e.g. table, bar, line.

native_sql.description: The SQL text when the question is a native query.

archived.description: Whether the question is in the trash.

parameters.description: Filter parameters the question accepts (id, slug, type, ...).

create_model.description: Save a model: a curated table, built from SQL or a query-builder query, that others explore with the query builder. Give exactly one of sql or query. SQL is checked, and its {{ }} filters defined, the same way as create_question.

sql.description: SQL for the model, a single read statement.

query.description: Query-builder (MBQL) query, e.g. {"source-table": 12, "aggregation": [["count"]], "breakout": [["field", 34, {"temporal-unit": "month"}]], "filter": [">", ["field", 56, null], 100]}. Field ids come from get_table. source-table can be a table id or "card__<question id>". SQL is not allowed here.

display.description: Visualization type, e.g. table, bar, line.

native_sql.description: The SQL text when the question is a native query.

archived.description: Whether the question is in the trash.

parameters.description: Filter parameters the question accepts (id, slug, type, ...).

create_metric.description: Save a metric: an official, reusable calculation (such as revenue or active users) defined by a query-builder query with exactly one aggregation. On Metabase 0.49 it is saved as a table metric instead, which must be built on a table (not a saved question).

query.description: Query-builder (MBQL) query, e.g. {"source-table": 12, "aggregation": [["count"]], "breakout": [["field", 34, {"temporal-unit": "month"}]], "filter": [">", ["field", 56, null], 100]}. Field ids come from get_table. source-table can be a table id or "card__<question id>". SQL is not allowed here. Needs exactly one aggregation.

display.description: Visualization type, e.g. table, bar, line.

native_sql.description: The SQL text when the question is a native query.

archived.description: Whether the question is in the trash.

parameters.description: Filter parameters the question accepts (id, slug, type, ...).

note.description: Set when the metric was saved as a table metric (Metabase 0.49).

export_question_results.description: Run a saved question and return its results as CSV text, JSON rows or an Excel file, for more rows than run_question's 2,000 (up to 10,000, and at most 1,000,000 characters of CSV). The question is checked the same way as run_question. Excel files return every row and must be under 3.5 MB.

format.description: csv (default), json, or xlsx for an Excel file.

content.description: CSV text with a header row (csv).
The file content encoded as base64.

list_segments.description: List saved segments: named filters on a table, such as 'Active customers', usable in the query builder.

archived.description: Whether the segment is in the trash.

create_segment.description: Save a segment: a named filter on a table that anyone can pick in the query builder.

filter.description: Query-builder filter clause, e.g. ["and", [">", ["field", 12, null], 100], ["=", ["field", 13, null], "active"]].

archived.description: Whether the segment is in the trash.

update_segment.description: Change a segment's name, description or filter.

archived.description: Whether the segment is in the trash.

update_collection.description: Rename a collection, change its description, or move it into another collection (or to the top level with move_to_root).

parent_collection_id.description: Collection to move this one into.

move_to_root.description: true moves the collection to the top level.

location.description: Path of parent collection ids, e.g. /28/31/.

move_items.description: Move questions, models, metrics, dashboards or collections into a collection, or to the top level with move_to_root. Each item is moved separately and reports its own result.

collection_id.description: Collection to move the items into.

move_to_root.description: true moves the items to the top level.

items.description: One result per item: item_type, id, moved, and error when it failed.

archive_item.description: Move a question, model, metric, dashboard, collection, segment, subscription, timeline or timeline event to Metabase's trash, or turn an alert off. restore_item brings it back, as does Metabase's trash. Archiving a collection also archives what is inside it. Metabase deletes a question's alerts when the question is archived, and restoring it doesn't bring them back.

archived.description: Whether the item is now in the trash (or the alert off).

restore_item.description: Bring a question, model, metric, dashboard, collection, segment, subscription, timeline or timeline event back from Metabase's trash, or turn an alert back on.

archived.description: Whether the item is now in the trash (or the alert off).

list_alerts.description: List question alerts, optionally for one question.

include_inactive.description: Also list alerts that are turned off.

send_once.description: Whether the alert stops after its first send.

schedule.description: When the alert checks (cron on Metabase 0.54+, frequency and hour before).

create_alert.description: Email people when a saved question has results (has_result), or when a line, bar or progress chart's value goes above (goal_above) or below (goal_below) its goal line. Needs email set up in Metabase to send. The question is checked the same way as run_question first.

condition.description: has_result (default), goal_above or goal_below. Goal conditions need a goal set on the chart.

send_once.description: true stops the alert after its first send (default false).

frequency.description: How often: hourly, daily (default) or weekly.

hour.description: Hour of the day to send, 0-23 in the Metabase report timezone (default 8). Ignored for hourly.

recipient_user_ids.description: Metabase user ids to email (see list_users).

recipient_emails.description: Email addresses to send to (people without a Metabase login).

send_once.description: Whether the alert stops after its first send.

schedule.description: When the alert checks (cron on Metabase 0.54+, frequency and hour before).

list_subscriptions.description: List dashboard subscriptions (scheduled emails of a dashboard), optionally for one dashboard.

archived.description: List turned-off (archived) subscriptions instead.
Whether the subscription is turned off (in the trash).

skip_if_empty.description: Whether sends are skipped when every question is empty.

create_subscription.description: Email a dashboard (every question on it) to people on a schedule. Needs email set up in Metabase to send. Each question on it is checked the same way as run_question first.

skip_if_empty.description: true skips a send when every question is empty (default false).

frequency.description: How often: hourly, daily (default) or weekly.

hour.description: Hour of the day to send, 0-23 in the Metabase report timezone (default 8). Ignored for hourly.

recipient_user_ids.description: Metabase user ids to email (see list_users).

recipient_emails.description: Email addresses to send to (people without a Metabase login).

archived.description: Whether the subscription is turned off (in the trash).

skip_if_empty.description: Whether sends are skipped when every question is empty.

update_subscription.description: Change a dashboard subscription's schedule, recipients, name or skip-if-empty setting. Only the fields given change; recipient lists given replace the old ones. Turn a subscription off with archive_item.

skip_if_empty.description: true skips a send when every question is empty.

frequency.description: How often: hourly, daily (default) or weekly.

hour.description: Hour of the day to send, 0-23 in the Metabase report timezone (default 8). Ignored for hourly.

recipient_user_ids.description: Metabase user ids to email (see list_users).

recipient_emails.description: Email addresses to send to (people without a Metabase login).

archived.description: Whether the subscription is turned off (in the trash).

skip_if_empty.description: Whether sends are skipped when every question is empty.

list_users.description: List Metabase users, to pick alert and subscription recipients. Usually needs an API key in the Administrators group.

query.description: Only users whose name or email contains this text.

update_table.description: Change the name or description Metabase shows for a table. The database itself is not changed. Needs a data-model admin API key.

update_field.description: Change the name, description or semantic type Metabase shows for a column. The database itself is not changed. Needs a data-model admin API key.

semantic_type.description: What the column means to Metabase, e.g. type/Email, type/Currency, type/Category, type/FK, type/PK, type/City.

foreign_key_target_field_id.description: Field this column points to, when it is a foreign key.

sync_database.description: Ask Metabase to pick up new or changed tables and columns in a database, for example after a new table is created. Runs in the background. Needs an admin API key.

rescan_field_values.description: Ask Metabase to refresh the values it lists in filter dropdowns for a database's columns. Runs in the background. Needs an admin API key.

list_timelines.description: List event timelines with their events. Events show as markers on time-series charts in the same collection.

archived.description: List archived timelines instead.

timelines.description: Timelines: id, name, description, collection_id, archived, events.

create_timeline.description: Create an event timeline in a collection, for markers such as releases or campaigns on that collection's time-series charts.

collection_id.description: Collection the timeline belongs to (default: root).

create_timeline_event.description: Add an event, such as a release, campaign or incident, to a timeline. It shows as a marker on time-series charts.

time_matters.description: true shows the time of day, not just the date (default false).

archived.description: Whether the event is in the trash.

update_timeline_event.description: Change a timeline event's name, description, date or time.

time_matters.description: true shows the time of day.

archived.description: Whether the event is in the trash.
